description: Generate retained ordered integer-cell rectangles by attempt-bounded binary cuts with random or longer-axis selection.

provenance.relationship: Extract integer-cell binary layout with explicit axis policy; source RNG quirks and decorative composition remain outside.
Extract integer-cell binary layout with explicit axis policy; source RNG quirks and decorative composition remain outside.

output_invariants: Exact ordered positive nonoverlapping integer rectangles cover the root; size=splits+1, splits<=attempts; detached exports.

behavior.generation: Private seeded ordered live-leaf selection, RANDOM or LONGEST axis, failed unit-axis attempts consume no cut; successful cuts cover every interior integer boundary under unit mapping; remove parent preserving survivors then append low/high children. Exact consumption and arithmetic in normative contract.
behavior.environment: Private xoshiro128**1.1/SplitMix64 as seeded-quadrant-partition; no host globals, renderer, time or assets.
behavior.ownership: Immutable retained values; copied exports; boundsInto validates before allocation-free writes.
behavior.complexity: O(attempts*maximumLiveCount) worst-case work; O(finalLiveCount) storage; grow by actual successes. Representation bounds are not memory promises.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid configuration carrier, keys or values.
errors.INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: Valid numeric index outside retained sequence.
errors.INVALID_OUTPUT: Null or non-length4 destination; index checked first, no partial writes.

seed.evidence: Explicit deterministic design, no source stream replay.

columns.evidence: Both source layouts use integer cells; representation domain not visual recommendation.

rows.evidence: Both source layouts use integer cells; caller scales to drawing units.

attempts.evidence: CP17 private experiment20/80/240; fewer actual splits with saturation; no encouraged interval.

axisPolicy.evidence: poop random-axis and barab longer-axis; CP17 native comparison supports retaining both.
